Maria (CS): Heads-up: running an early-look experience interview round for 6 pilot seats next week to capture setup friction + feature gaps. Need to coordinate enrollments, survey + who can join calls. Looking for volunteers for note-taking and follow-ups.
Ajay (PM): Proposed slots Tue/Wed 10-11am PT. Can ENG join for live infra Qs? @Kelly (SE) can you take Wed?
Kelly (SE): I can do Wed 10am PT. I'll bring a quick onboarding checklist and the link to the internal runbook: https://redwood.ai/onboard/checklist — will drop the snippet here.
Dorian (Research): For capture, let's use the 8-question micro-survey + call rubric. I'll post the form and the call script. Survey link: `https://forms.redwood.com/early-look?pid=EL-2025`
Maria (CS): Perfect — I'll DM the cohort roster and send calendar invites once we lock the slot. Need owners: notes + tag renewal-risk signals (SSO blockers, data residency concerns, throughput complaints). @Kelly can you own the SSO questions & quick remediation checklist?
Kelly (SE): :thumbsup: I'll own the SSO script. Note for Okta+SCIM customers: add the provisioning flag `scim.enabled=true` in the onboarding YAML to avoid duplicate accounts. Example snippet: `provisioning:\n  scim:\n    enabled: true`
Ajay (PM): Can someone record the session? If we surface activation friction we'll capture CTAs and spin up engineering stories.
OnboardBot: Calendar event created: Early Look Interviews — Wed 2025-06-18 10:00 PT. Attendees: Maria, Ajay, Kelly, Dorian. Meet link: https://meet.redwood.com/earlylook-xxx
Maria (CS): Plan = 15-min intro + 15-min product walk + 20-min feedback (10 survey + 10 open). Post-call: send Loom + micro-survey. Post-call owners: Maria send invites & loom, Kelly SSO doc, Dorian survey results, Ajay compile highlights + deal-risk tags.
Kelly (SE): I'll prepare a 2-slide "Known issues & workarounds" doc and share before the call.
Ajay (PM): Reminder to capture a 1-5 "likelihood to recommend" and flag any "deal-breaker" infra items. We'll push those straight into the backlog with urgency tags.
Maria (CS): Thanks team. I'll post attendee roster + invite in ~30m. If anyone else wants to join live for customer Qs, ping me. :sparkles:
